title: Offtaker identified with a signed agreement
why: Without a signed offtake agreement the project has no contracted revenue.
how: The check needs a buyer party on an offtake agreement and a verified signing date.

evidence.heading: Parties
evidence.paragraph_text: This Agreement is made between Brackenfield Solar Limited (the "Generator") and Northwind Energy Supply Limited (the "Buyer").

evidence.heading: Execution
evidence.paragraph_text: Signed for and on behalf of Northwind Energy Supply Limited on 3 March 2025.
